mapper.sql: SELECT t.*, COALESCE(c.name, s.name) AS partner_name, u.nickname AS create_by_name FROM fin_note t LEFT JOIN scm_customer c ON t.kind = 'RECEIVABLE' AND c.id = t.partner_id LEFT JOIN scm_supplier s ON t.kind = 'PAYABLE' AND s.id = t.partner_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = t.create_by
mapper.update: UPDATE fin_note SET status = #{to}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = #{from}
